extDescription.message: Translates speech bubbles in images (comics, manga, webtoons). Free, no account, text recognition runs locally.

cmdTranslatePage.message: Translate all images on the page

menuTranslateImage.message: Translate the bubbles in this image

menuTranslatePage.message: Translate all images on the page

popupOcrLang.message: Language of the text in the image

popupTranslatePage.message: Translate all images on the page

popupHint.message: Single image: right-click it, then “Translate the bubbles in this image”. Whole page: Alt+T.

popupHintCache.message: The first use of a language downloads its recognition data (a few MB). Pages already translated then show up instantly.

popupCannot.message: Not possible on this page (browser pages, extension store…).

popupApp.message: On a phone or for a screenshot: the web app

errFetch.message: the website refuses to let the image be downloaded

welcomeIntro.message: The extension reads the text in speech bubbles and shows the translation on top. Everything is free.

welcomeStep1.message: One image: right-click it, then “Translate the bubbles in this image”.

welcomeStep2.message: A whole chapter: click the extension icon, then “Translate all images on the page”, or press Alt+T. Upcoming images are translated while you read.

welcomeStep3.message: Hands-free: in the extension window, tick “Translate automatically on this site”.

welcomeStep4.message: Click a translated bubble to see the original again.

welcomeTip.message: Tip: pin the extension (puzzle icon in the toolbar) to keep it at hand.

welcomePrivacy.message: Privacy: text recognition runs on your device. Only the bubble text is sent to the translation service you choose. The extension collects no data.
